title: Did not make me a Sexual Tyrannosaurus Rex as promised
text:
(Short review) No Gainz in these boxes and did not make me a Sexual Tyrannosaurus Rex as promised.
Totally not worth it. I was super excited to get my first box and it was filled with a coffee mug and some coffee samples. Second box came and it was a pair of jorts(Jean shorts) and another coffee mug. I wanted to give them one last chance. This last box was a message ball and a stretching strap. Totally not worth it. There were literally no Gainz in these boxes and did not make me a Sexual Tyrannosaurus Rex as promised.
label: negative
